caption: Cheerful children's sing-along song for preschool TV in the style of modern nursery-rhyme channels, warm friendly lead vocals with a happy group of cartoon animal voices joining on the chorus, call and response, bright ukulele, glockenspiel, hand claps, bouncy bass, light drums, playful animal sound effects, catchy repeating chorus, happy, major key, polished modern kids music production, clear diction, easy for toddlers to sing along
lyrics:
[Intro]
Hey hey! It's the Paws and Claws Club!
Let's find the colours! Let's go!

[Chorus]
Red and yellow, green and blue,
Colours all around for me and you!
Look up high and look down low,
Paws and Claws, let's find a rainbow!

[Verse]
Rory found something red, red, red,
A big red apple on the garden bed!
Red, red, can you see?
Point to something red with me!

[Chorus]
Red and yellow, green and blue,
Colours all around for me and you!
Look up high and look down low,
Paws and Claws, let's find a rainbow!

[Verse]
Ziggy found something yellow and bright,
A yellow sunflower, what a sight!
Yellow, yellow, can you see?
Point to something yellow with me!

[Chorus]
Red and yellow, green and blue,
Colours all around for me and you!
Look up high and look down low,
Paws and Claws, let's find a rainbow!

[Verse]
Waffles found something green, green, green,
The greenest leaf he's ever seen!
Green, green, can you see?
Point to something green with me!

[Chorus]
Red and yellow, green and blue,
Colours all around for me and you!
Look up high and look down low,
Paws and Claws, let's find a rainbow!

[Verse]
Pebble found something blue, blue, blue,
The big blue sky and the ocean too!
Blue, blue, can you see?
Point to something blue with me!

[Bridge]
Red! Yellow! Green! Blue!
A rainbow of colours for me and you!
Red! Yellow! Green! Blue!
Hooray for the rainbow, woo hoo hoo!

[Chorus]
Red and yellow, green and blue,
Colours all around for me and you!
Look up high and look down low,
Paws and Claws, let's find a rainbow!

[Chorus]
Red and yellow, green and blue,
Colours all around for me and you!
Look up high and look down low,
Paws and Claws, let's find a rainbow!

[Outro]
Bye bye, friends! See you next time!
